# Colton's Games Hub

> A Windows 95-inspired browser desktop and launcher for original browser games, classic arcade remakes, small utilities, and a shared chatroom. Built primarily with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript by Colton Bennett. Live at https://coltjbennett.github.io/games-hub/

The site is deployed as a static GitHub Pages project. It has a desktop-style shell with draggable/resizable windows, a taskbar, themes, catalogue search, favorites/recents, utility applets, and best-effort offline caching. Many game pages load versioned CDN libraries directly; the service worker caches local resources and selected static CDN assets when available. Live APIs, remote repositories, MQTT connections, proxy requests, YouTube embeds, and some third-party game content remain network-dependent.

Do not assume that chat DMs are confidential: the chat uses browser-side logic and public MQTT transport, and exported chat history may be publicly accessible. Do not share sensitive information through the chat.

## Main entry points
- [Home / Desktop launcher](https://coltjbennett.github.io/games-hub/): Main interface for the site's project catalogue and desktop applets.
- [index.html](https://coltjbennett.github.io/games-hub/index.html): Explicit homepage URL.
- [Third-party Web Arcade](https://coltjbennett.github.io/games-hub/games.html): Directory that obtains game entries from a separate GitHub repository and uses Ruffle for SWF content.
- [Chatroom](https://coltjbennett.github.io/games-hub/applets/chatroom.html): Integrated MQTT chat and browser-side history/synchronization.
- [README](https://coltjbennett.github.io/games-hub/README.md): Project overview, layout, deployment, dependency, and privacy notes.
- [Changelog](https://coltjbennett.github.io/games-hub/changelog.txt): Recorded releases and fixes.
- [TODO](https://coltjbennett.github.io/games-hub/TODO.txt): Known follow-ups and ideas.
- [License](https://coltjbennett.github.io/games-hub/LICENSE.txt): Copyright and reuse terms.

## Original games and experiments
- [Asphalt Rush](https://coltjbennett.github.io/games-hub/games/asphalt-rush.html): Night-city driving/racing with police pursuit, vehicle customization, upgrades, and progression.
- [Pixel Ops](https://coltjbennett.github.io/games-hub/games/pixel-ops.html): Separate single-player FPS with 3D rendering, weapons, missions, achievements, and touch controls. The supplied source does not implement the MQTT multiplayer used by the FPS beta.
- [Ghengis Khan Simulator](https://coltjbennett.github.io/games-hub/games/ghengis.html): Historical strategy/battlefield simulation with units, placement, terrain, and combat.
- [MEGALITH](https://coltjbennett.github.io/games-hub/games/megalith.html): Neon 3D endless-runner/arcade game with platforms and crystals.
- [City Striker](https://coltjbennett.github.io/games-hub/games/city-striker.html): Driving and police-chase arcade game.
- [Chronostrike](https://coltjbennett.github.io/games-hub/games/chronostrike.html): First-person action game built around movement-dependent time.
- [Labyrinthine](https://coltjbennett.github.io/games-hub/games/labyrinthine.html): Survival-horror maze concept; marked in-progress/on hold in the catalogue.
- [Goblin Hut Clicker](https://coltjbennett.github.io/games-hub/games/gh-clicker.html): Idle/clicker game with buildings, research, upgrades, and persistent progress.
- [Legacy Racing Sim](https://coltjbennett.github.io/games-hub/games/legacysim.html): Older playable racing game using 2D drawing to imitate a 3D view.
- [Royal Clash](https://coltjbennett.github.io/games-hub/games/clash.html): Early tower-defense/card-battler-inspired project.
- [Engine Sim](https://coltjbennett.github.io/games-hub/games/enginesim.html): Configurable mechanical/engine simulation.
- [Warzone](https://coltjbennett.github.io/games-hub/games/warzone.html): Military vehicle combat simulator with aircraft, helicopters, and tanks.
- [Gang Wars](https://coltjbennett.github.io/games-hub/games/gangwars.html): Top-down action game with combat and progression.
- [Racing Sim](https://coltjbennett.github.io/games-hub/games/badracingsim.html): Abandoned/incomplete racing physics prototype; Legacy Racing Sim is the more playable alternative.
- [FPS beta](https://coltjbennett.github.io/games-hub/games/fps.html): Experimental MQTT-based multiplayer FPS/engine test, not a finished game.
- [Fieldkit 3D Engine](https://coltjbennett.github.io/games-hub/games/fieldkit_3d_engine.html): Single-file Three.js/cannon-es game-engine and physics sandbox, with character/vehicle controllers, object interaction, world tuning, and touch support. This is an engine foundation rather than a finished standalone game.

## Built-in applets
- [Universal MQTT Chat](https://coltjbennett.github.io/games-hub/applets/chatroom.html): Global room, DM-style tabs, replies, reactions, mentions, attachments, and activity/presence.
- [Scientific Calculator](https://coltjbennett.github.io/games-hub/applets/calculator.html): Mathematical functions and constants.
- [Clock](https://coltjbennett.github.io/games-hub/applets/clock.html): Local clock, stopwatch, and alarm.
- [Control Panel](https://coltjbennett.github.io/games-hub/applets/control-panel.html): Themes, visual/accessibility preferences, window behavior, and layout controls.
- [Project Snippet Generator](https://coltjbennett.github.io/games-hub/applets/makedata.html): Helps create project entries for `data.js`.
- [Notes](https://coltjbennett.github.io/games-hub/applets/notes.html): Browser-local notes.
- [Paint](https://coltjbennett.github.io/games-hub/applets/paint.html): Canvas drawing/editor applet.
- [System Monitor](https://coltjbennett.github.io/games-hub/applets/system-monitor.html): Browser storage diagnostics and local data export/import utilities.
- [Timer](https://coltjbennett.github.io/games-hub/applets/timer.html): Countdown timer.
- [Weather](https://coltjbennett.github.io/games-hub/applets/weather.html): Weather lookup, forecasts, and charts using live external data.
- [Proxy Browser Applet](https://coltjbennett.github.io/games-hub/applets/web_proxy_browser_applet.html): Experimental embedded/proxy browser; arbitrary sites and their assets are not guaranteed to render or work.

## Project structure and technical references
- `index.html`, `main.js`, `styles.css`: desktop shell and window manager.
- `data.js`: site metadata and catalogue entries.
- `service-worker.js`: local precache manifest, versioned cache lifecycle, and best-effort runtime cache.
- `manifest.webmanifest`: installable-app metadata.
- `offline.html`: offline navigation fallback.
- `games/`: original games and experiments.
- `games/classics/`: classic arcade remakes.
- `applets/`: desktop utilities and chat.
- `images/`: thumbnails, icons, cursors, font files, and retro background assets.
- `package.json`: inventory of CDN dependency versions. Pages load these libraries directly from CDNs; there is no build/bundling step.

## Dependency version notes
Several versions coexist by design. The supplied pages reference Three.js r128 / npm 0.128.0, 0.160.0, and 0.186.1; Cannon.js 0.6.2 and cannon-es 0.20.0; NippleJS 0.9.0 and 0.10.1; MQTT.js 4.3.7; localForage 1.10.0; LZ-String 1.5.0; Chart.js 4.5.1 plus an unversioned Chart.js URL in the weather applet; JSZip 3.10.1; Ruffle 0.6.0 plus an unversioned Ruffle URL in the arcade; and x-frame-bypass 1.0.2. Google Fonts are also used by some games. The service worker keeps distinct referenced URLs rather than assuming only one version is needed.
